slow.scope: Only complete ASCII exact-format lines from the frozen static GatewaySlowStage label/phase/class allowlists. observedAtMs is the launcher receive clock, not server span start/end. connection is an opaque diagnostic counter, never identity or an action/request ID; queuedPhase and phaseElapsedMs were sampled when the input was queued. Queued counts alone do not prove durable output when incomplete. Existing50ms logging is left-censored; missing rows do not prove absence of a stall.

store.scope: Only complete ASCII exact-format lines from the frozen static GatewaySlowStage label/phase/class allowlists. Account-store rows use separate fixed stage/operation allowlists and scalar-only metadata; malformed targeted account_store lines stop this capture. Their durationMs is the floored maximum completed single occurrence; samples and totalUs aggregate same-stage occurrences, nested stages overlap and must not be summed. Endpoint microsecond truncation can add one microsecond to their difference. traceId is an opaque process-local record counter, not identity; only completed records emit after their business guards release, so missing rows do not prove an ongoing holder is absent. observedAtMs is the launcher receive clock, not server span start/end. connection is an opaque diagnostic counter, never identity or an action/request ID; queuedPhase and phaseElapsedMs were sampled when the input was queued. Queued counts alone do not prove durable output when incomplete. Existing50ms logging is left-censored; missing rows do not prove absence of a stall.

independentDatasetValidation.scope: Independent completed account-store scalar projection only. Queued callback counts are compared with actual ended JSONL; they are not durable proof alone. Completeness is diagnostic only, never game acceptance, ACK credit, a holder/deadlock diagnosis, or proof of absence.
